name: Catastrophic
description: Results in multiple fatalities or system loss
example: Uncontrolled release of toxic gas causing multiple deaths; aircraft crash

name: Critical
description: Results in major injury or single fatality or major system damage
example: Brake failure causing serious collision; single occupant fatality

name: Major
description: Results in minor injury or significant system degradation
example: Overtemperature causing equipment damage requiring replacement; minor burn

name: Minor
description: Results in negligible injury or minor system degradation
example: Warning system false alarm; cosmetic equipment damage

name: Negligible
description: Results in no injury or trivial system degradation
example: Minor display flicker; negligible wear on non-critical component
